d003_runtime_reference.note: Runtime CURRENT_DATE form. Evaluation reproduces the D-003 decision with the explicitly pinned evaluation_as_of_date captured from the governing connection (see evaluation_as_of_date). The pinned predicate matches D-003 exactly when the pinned date equals that connection's CURRENT_DATE, which capture guarantees by construction: same connection, no override, one shared date for the run.

classification_inputs.corpus_note: Pinned evaluation corpus rows only. No raw text, no 신청기한 parsing, no age/income/region/add_qualify inference, no LLM/model, no score, no protected labels/results, no source-specific guesswork.

evaluation_as_of_date.capture_connection: The exact DB connection context governing the pinned evaluation corpus and the paired D-003 baseline/candidate.
evaluation_as_of_date.capture_timing: Executed exactly once for capture BEFORE protected plaintext access and BEFORE run_start.
evaluation_as_of_date.capture_override_prohibition: Do NOT apply SET TIME ZONE or any timezone/session override for capture.
evaluation_as_of_date.pin: Pin the returned values as db_session_timezone (as returned by the DB) and evaluation_as_of_date (SELECT CURRENT_DATE, canonical ISO YYYY-MM-DD) in corpus/evaluation provenance and audit.
evaluation_as_of_date.mutability: Immutable for the entire run and shared by Candidate A and the paired D-003 baseline. The later implementation must use the same pinned date for BOTH sides rather than allowing midnight drift, e.g. (biz_end IS NULL OR biz_end >= :evaluation_as_of_date) with audit production_excluded = biz_end IS NOT NULL AND biz_end < evaluation_as_of_date.
evaluation_as_of_date.fail_closed: Missing/malformed/error => HOLD; never fall back to OS/user/local/UTC date.
evaluation_as_of_date.freeze_stage_note: This D-053 freeze stage sets no value and performs no DB query to obtain one.

db_session_timezone.role: Provenance only, never a permanent expected value.
db_session_timezone.recording: Recorded as returned by the DB at capture. Do NOT hardcode any timezone value.
db_session_timezone.note: Observed values in evidence (see supersession doc) are evidence only. If DB config changes later, capture what actually governs CURRENT_DATE.

predicate.production_excluded: biz_end is not null AND biz_end < evaluation_as_of_date
predicate.equivalence: Pinned-date reproduction of the D-003 runtime predicate; exact parity holds when the pinned date is the governing connection's CURRENT_DATE at capture.
